notes.title: Update! Version 1.2 Hercules.
notes.content:

notes.title: August 2018 Revision - Version 1.1.5 Phoenix.
notes.content:
[h1][b]No tutorials?[/b][/h1]
[b]There seems to be some confusion.. Yes there is![/b]
[list][*][url=https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLWuuBrcVEm3kY-Q8nvEk5FUreX7ulTuiL&playnext=1&index=1]Mission Control Auxiliary Defense Guide[/url] [i]Beginner, Completed[/i]
[*][url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=j2OI_XdlOjI&list=PLWuuBrcVEm3nylSNK_Sb53SmPHZfMBl36&index=1]Mission Control Advanced Guilde[/url] [i]Advanced, On going[/i]
[*][url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=R82a_24CMGQ&list=PLWuuBrcVEm3nPDs9K0Qa0tpZAQnshKR9L&index=1]Informal[/url] [i]Completed, not really tutorials.[/i][/list]

[h1][b]Why not in beta branch?[/b][/h1]
[i]Version 1.1.4 Phoenix[/i] in the [i]Production branch[/i] suffered from serious problems that appeared after we applied a patch we received for the [i]Engine[/i] in order to fix [i]Load Time Degradation[/i].

At the moment it was brought to our attention, the [i]August Revision[/i] contained many other improvements and we decided to release the [i]August Revision[/i] in the [i]Production branch[/i] for this month.

Before, or around, [i]September 1st[/i] we will release [i]Version 1.2[/i].

[h1][b]Central Command Request Program[/b]:[/h1]
[list][*]Central will request from time to time [b][url=https://recogthegame.com/Wiki/COMPONENTS.html]Components[/url][/b] and trade them for [b][url=https://recogthegame.com/Wiki/FRAGMENTS.html]Fragments[/url][/b].

[*] The first request happens on [b]Cycle 14[/b].
Note: For those of who who are already way past that, It will begin on the [b][i]Next Cycle[/i][/b].

[*]  In order for Central to perform the [i]Exchange[/i] [b]all[/b] the [b][url=https://recogthegame.com/Wiki/COMPONENTS.html]Components[/url][/b] will need to be placed in the [b]same[/b] [b][url=https://recogthegame.com/Wiki/CONSTRUCT_STORAGE.html]Storage containment unit[/url][/b] furthermore it will need to be [b]exposed[/b] with [b]no[/b] [i]Non-Walkable[/i] cells above it [b]all the way[/b] to [i]Depth[/i] [b]130[/b].

[*] Central will send beams from time to time to your [b]exposed[/b] [b][url=https://recogthegame.com/Wiki/CONSTRUCT_STORAGE.html]Storage containment unit[/url][/b] scanning the content and then performing the [i]Exchange[/i].

[*] The first [i]Request[/i] is [b]4[/b] [b][url=https://recogthegame.com/Wiki/COMPONENTS.html]Components[/url][/b].
Each time a [i]Request[/i] is fulfilled the next one is increased by [b]1[/b] to a maximum of [b]48[/b].
After a [i]Request[/i] is fulfilled the next one will come in [b]2[/b] Cycles.
The more  [b][url=https://recogthegame.com/Wiki/COMPONENTS.html]Components[/url][/b] are traded the more, and better, [b][url=https://recogthegame.com/Wiki/FRAGMENTS.html]Fragments[/url][/b] you will obtain.

[*] The [i]Request[/i] will expire in [b]5[/b] Cycles.
Each time a [i]Request[/i] is failed the next one is decreased by [b]1[/b] to minimum of [b]4[/b].
After a [i]Request[/i] is failed the next one will come in [b]3[/b] Cycles.

[*]  You can access current [i]Request[/i] next to the [i]Event Log Window[/i] icon.
Note: A visual will appear should there be a current [i]Request[/i] from Central.[/list]
[h1][b]RECOG A.I Improvements[/b]:[/h1]
[list][*][b]Combat[/b]:
RECOGs with work better together when trying to breach an [i]Ambush/[i].

[*][b]Same Team Traffic[/b]:
RECOGs will now also make way when [i]Engaged[/i], provided they can remain so.

[*][b]Same Team Traffic[/b]:
RECOGs will no longer move out of the way should they be [url=https://recogthegame.com/Wiki/STATUS_STANDSTILL.html][b]Halted[/b][/url] and will respect [b][url=https://recogthegame.com/Wiki/STATUS_RESTRICTED.html]Restriction[/url][/b] as well before moving out of the way.

[*][b]Combat Efficiency[/b]:
RECOGs will use additional lasers more efficiently; when moving, when waiting in traffic, etc.
Note: Your [i]Ambush[/i] may require some [i]Strategic Improvements![/i][/list]
[h1][b]Interface Improvements[/b]:[/h1]
[list][*][b]Category Counts[/b]:
 Now also displayed if containing 0.

[*][b]Event Log Window[/b]:
 Will now log when [b][url=https://recogthegame.com/Wiki/CIVILIAN.html]Utility Drones[/url][/b] abandon a collectible with a *Reason*.

[*][b]Production Window[/b]:
 [i]"Parts Of"[/i] section now with categories.

[*][b]Production Window[/b]:
 [i]"Parts Of"[/i] section now can fetch parts from a [b][url=https://recogthegame.com/Wiki/BluePage.html]Blueprints[/url][/b] fetching the [b][url=https://recogthegame.com/Wiki/CONSTRUCTS.html]Constructs[/url][/b] list.
Note: [b][url=https://recogthegame.com/Wiki/CONSTRUCTS.html]Constructs[/url][/b] not unlocked will be ignored.[/list]
[h1][b]Controls Improvements[/b]:[/h1]
[list][*][b]Edge Of Screen Panning[/b]:
[i]Optional[/i] and [i]Configurable[/i] in the [i]Controls[/i] section of the [i]Options[/i].
[b]Disabled[/b] by default.

[*][b]Free rotation on the left and right direction[/b]. (Y Axis)
[i]Key Combination[/i] with [b]Q[/b] and [b]E[/b].
[i]Configurable[/i] in the [i]Controls[/i] section of the [i]Options[/i].
[b]Left Shift[/b] and [b]Right Shift[/b] by default.

[*][b]Mouse drag rotation on the left and right direction[/b]. (Y Axis)
[i]Mouse button only[/i], drag horizontally to rotate.
[i]Configurable[/i] in the [i]Controls[/i] section of the [i]Options[/i]. 
[b]Button 2[/b] by default, typically the middle mouse button.

[*][b][url=https://recogthegame.com/Wiki/BluePage.html]Blueprints[/url] rotation key changes[/b]:
Now uses same [i]Key Combination[/i] as above for [b]Free rotation on the left and right direction[/b].
Previously it was [i]Hard-Coded[/i] to [b]Right Shift[/b] and [b]Left Shift[/b] keys.
Note: Remains undocumented.
[i]Soon[/i] will be covered in an [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=j2OI_XdlOjI&list=PLWuuBrcVEm3nylSNK_Sb53SmPHZfMBl36&index=1][b]Mission Control Auxiliary Advanced Guide[/b][/url] video.[/list]
[h1][b]More to come before Version 1.2[/b]:[/h1]
[list][*][b]Drone groups management[/b].
[*][b]Experimental multi display option(s)[/b].
[*][b]Possibly more…[/b]
[*]See the [url=https://forum.recogthegame.com/topic/74/august-2018-milestone-all-feedback-welcomed][b]August 2018 Milestone[/b][/url] topic or posts in the [url=https://forum.recogthegame.com/category/8/feature-requests][b]Feature Requests[/b][/url] category for more details.[/list]
[h1][b]Performance increase[/b]:[/h1]
[list][*]Better frame rate and memory management when displaying large amount of [b][url=https://recogthegame.com/Wiki/CONSTRUCT_SWITCH.html]Signal EFX[/url][/b].
[*]AI computation time to obtain [b][url=https://recogthegame.com/Wiki/STATS_TARGETS_LASER.html]additional targets[/url][/b] greatly improved.
[*]Path finding less "chunky" when dealing with very large amount of destroyed [b][url=https://recogthegame.com/Wiki/CONSTRUCTS.html]Constructs[/url][/b] at once.
[*]Improved computation times regarding the [b][url=https://recogthegame.com/Wiki/STATS_EFFECT_RICOCHET.html]Dual-angular impulse[/url][/b] and [b][url=https://recogthegame.com/Wiki/STATS_EFFECT_RICOCHET2.html]Tri-angular impulse[/url][/b] effects.[/list]
[h1][b]Bugs fixed[/b]:[/h1]
[list][*][b]Fixed [i]Game Over[/i] screen from being completely broken[/b].
[*]Fixed [b][url=https://recogthegame.com/Wiki/MODULES.html]Modules[/url][/b] from not showing up in inventory [b]making it impossible to equip them[/b].
[*]Fixed [b][url=https://recogthegame.com/Wiki/UNITS.html]Drones[/url][/b] from [b]stacking[/b] in specific conditions.
[*]Fixed [b][url=https://recogthegame.com/Wiki/UNITS.html]Drones[/url][/b] manual move order [b]Material to turn Pink[/b] when more than 1 at the same time.
[*]Fixed [b][url=https://recogthegame.com/Wiki/UNITS.html]Drones[/url][/b] stretched [b]Thrusts EFX[/b] in specific conditions.
[*]Fixed [b][url=https://recogthegame.com/Wiki/UNITSKILL_JUGGERNAUT3.html]Absorb[/url] EFX[/b] wrongly placed. 
[*]Fixed [b][url=https://recogthegame.com/Wiki/UNITSKILL_JUGGERNAUT1.html]Tractor beam[/url] EFX[/b] wrongly placed.
[*][b][url=https://forum.recogthegame.com/category/7/bug-reports]Others[/url][/b].[/list]
[h1][b]Warnings[/b]:[/h1]
[list][*]Saves made with version 1.1.5 will not be backward compatible.
[*][b]The enemies will be harder to deal with![/b]
[*]Adjust your strategies.
[*]Save often.[/list]
[h1][b]Availability/Vacations[/b]:[/h1]
[list][*][b]We will not be available from August 10 to August 17 inclusively[/b].
[b]Thank you for understanding[/b].[/list]
[h1][b]Thank you all for your participation and feedback![/b][/h1]
[list][*][b]We take bugs and performance very seriously, please report any problems[/b].
[*]Special thanks to: @youarethemusic, @CVAR83, @Neemys  and @Abstruse-Paradox.
[*]Visit our [url=https://forum.recogthegame.com]Official Forum[/url] for more information about [url=https://forum.recogthegame.com/topic/82/august-2018-revision-version-1-1-5-phoenix]this[/url] announcement.[/list]

notes.title: Revision in Beta branch!
notes.content:
[h1]New options in Production Window for Elemental, Foundry and Assembly depots.[/h1][list]
[*]New action: Industrial Parts automatically chosen based on desired end result.
[*]New actions: Clear, Copy, Paste, Save and Load Industrial Queue.
[*]New options: Retry and Shuffle.[/list]
[h1]Experimental Event Log Window[/h1][list]
[*]Logs 5 categories of events: Industry, Drones, Constructs, Wiring, Terrain.[/list]
[h1]User Interface changes.[/h1][list]
[*]Categories display count and limits where applicable.
[*]Highlight Information now refresh.
[*]Non-Generator power-able Constructs now also display total possible available power.
[*]Technology Descriptions now contains more detailed stats.[/list]
[h1]Options and Keys Configuration changes.[/h1][list]
[*]New option: Enable Background Processing.
[*]Mouse Wheel: Now also zoom in and out.
[*]Binds: Support Mouse Binding.
[*]Binds: Top-Mode bind now configurable.
[*]Binds: Top-Mode second default bind “T”.
[*]Binds: Wiki Home removed. Was “F1”.[/list]
[h1]Improved Performance.[/h1][list]
[*]Faster User Interface synchronization: better performance on events and mouse over.
[*]Improved Memory Management: better performance in battles and overall.
[*]Improved Physics computations time: better performance on event.
[*]More.. See below for full list.[/list]
[h1]Fixed Bugs.[/h1][list]
[*]See below for full list.[/list]
[h1]What? How? Details? Warnings? Comments? Full list?[/h1][list]
[*]See the [url=https://forum.recogthegame.com/topic/31/july-2018-revision-change-log]full announcement on our forum![/url][/list]

notes.title: Release!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Please read, IN FULL, before purchasing.[/b][/h1]

[i]This game is [b]not[/b] for everyone, it is a [b]very challenging[/b] and [b]sophisticated[/b] game.
It was designed and intended as such.

If you are uncertain this game is for you, please take a moment to view some of the tutorials before making a decision about purchasing this game. (see tutorials link below)

We would rather have happy clients, then frustrated ones.

We are available to provide help and support via the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/843040/discussions/]Steam Community Discussion forum[/url], the [url=https://forum.recogthegame.com/]Official forum[/url] or Social media such as [url=https://twitter.com/LozMarblz]Twitter[/url].[/i]

[h1][b]There are no in-game tutorials.[/b][/h1]

[i]Due to the game complexity and its enormous possibilities,
tutorials inside the game would simply not due justice to the user’s experience.[/i]
[b]However there are quite a few video tutorials available here:[/b]
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BS6RBB0CKt8&list=PLWuuBrcVEm3kY-Q8nvEk5FUreX7ulTuiL]MCADG - Mission Control Auxiliary Defense Guide[/url]

[h1][b]Upcoming[/b][/h1]

[i]We plan to release additional tutorials periodically,
as well as customized tutorials based on demand.[/i]

[i]We also plan to release a milestone approximately once a month.
If you would like to influence development, head over to the official forum here:[/i]
[url=https://forum.recogthegame.com/]RECOG The First Wave : Official forum[/url]

[b]CONTEST ANNOUNCEMENTS to come,
Stay tuned for a chance to win CASH PRIZES![/b]

[i][b]Thank you and HAVE FUN!!![/b][/i]
